newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal readies possible sale of BNU bank - paper.
newsitem.headline: Portugal readies possible sale of BNU bank - paper.

text.p: Portugal's government is preparing for a possible privatisation of Banco Nacional Ultramarino (BNU) by transferring its pension fund to social security system Caixa Geral de Aposentacoes, a senior official was quoted as saying.

Manuela Arcanjo, Under-Secretary for the Budget, told Diario Economico newspaper that the transfer of the pension fund, which was not a "financial cushion" for the 1997 budget, would take place early next year.
"This decision was taken with a view to a future privatisation of BNU, which is not part of the privatisations calendar," Arcanjo told the paper.
"Without this load (pension fund) the privatisation, whenever it happens, will have another value," she added.
Parliament is due to vote on the Socialist government's 1997 budget proposals on December 11.
The government's ambitious privatisation programme could bring in at least $450 million to state coffers this year and a similar sum in 1997.
